reviews.author: Bharat Chauhan
reviews.body: Is bracelet ka structured pattern mujhe kaafi stylish lagta hai. Simple outfit ke saath bhi ye wrist par ek polished finishing touch add kar sakta hai, especially jab minimal accessories preferred ho.

reviews.author: Mitali Choudhary
reviews.body: Agar aapko textured jewellery pasand hai but overly heavy pieces nahi, toh 3mm structure ek nice balance provide karta hai.

reviews.author: Aditya Choudhary
reviews.body: Cubic pattern aur sleek profile together ek luxe-inspired touch create karte hain. ✨

reviews.author: Faraz Siddiqui
reviews.body: Bracelet ko watch ke saath pair karne par ek coordinated aur stylish wrist stack ban sakta hai.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the bracelet around your wrist as a stylish everyday accessory.
• Secure the lock or closure properly and adjust it comfortably before stepping out.
• Style it alone for a clean minimal look or stack it with a watch, bangles, or other bracelets for a more polished wrist style.
• Wear it with casual outfits, office looks, festive wear, party fits, evening outfits, or daily styling.
• Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and finish.
• After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store it separately in a pouch or jewellery box.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the Cubic Richie Rich Bracelet — a bold yet refined piece designed around a sleek gold-toned chain structure, cubic Pyrite crystals, and glossy black Obsidian beads that instantly add power and character to your wrist.

The polished chain gives the bracelet a clean, structured, and premium look, while the cubic Pyrite adds a sharp, rich, and money-focused crystal touch. The Obsidian beads balance the design with a deep black finish that feels protective, grounding, and meaningful. It is minimal enough for everyday wear, but the black-gold and metallic crystal contrast makes it stand out beautifully when seen closely.

Pyrite is known as the Money Magnet Crystal, traditionally associated with wealth attraction, confidence, ambition, success, and abundance energy. Obsidian is known as a protection crystal, associated with grounding, nazar protection, emotional stability, and shielding away negative energy. Together, they create a bracelet that feels stylish, strong, and full of purpose.

Key Highlights

• Cubic Pyrite Crystals — known for wealth attraction, confidence, ambition, and success energy.
• Obsidian Beads — known for protection, grounding, and negative energy shielding.
• Bold Black-Gold Contrast — gives the bracelet a rich, powerful, and premium everyday look.
• Secure Lobster Lock Closure — easy to wear and comfortable for daily styling.
• Lightweight & Wearable — perfect for regular use, office looks, casual outfits, festive styling, and gifting.

Wear it solo for a clean crystal statement or pair it with a watch and other bracelets for a more layered, confident wrist look.

Whether you are buying it for yourself or gifting it to someone, the Cubic Richie Rich Bracelet is made for those who like jewellery that feels stylish, meaningful, and energetically powerful.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Can I wear this bracelet daily?

Yes, this bracelet is suitable for daily styling as well as special occasions.

Q2. Is this bracelet comfortable to wear?

Yes, it is designed to feel lightweight and comfortable for regular wear.

Q3. Does it have a secure closure?

Yes, the bracelet comes with a secure lock or closure for easy and comfortable wearing.

Q4. Can I stack it with other bracelets?

Yes, you can wear it alone for a minimal look or stack it with other bracelets for a more styled wrist look.

Q5. Is this bracelet good for gifting?

Yes, it makes a stylish and thoughtful gift for birthdays, festive occasions, celebrations, and everyday jewellery lovers.

Q6. What outfits can I style it with?

You can style it with casual outfits, office looks, festive wear, party fits, evening outfits, and daily wear.

Q7. How should I care for this bracelet?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Wipe gently after use and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box.
